import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import cleaning

rows = [
    {"name": "  ada LOVELACE ", "email": " ADA@Example.com", "age": 36},
    {"name": "bob", "email": None, "age": " 41 "},
    {"email": "X@Y.Z "},
]
original = [dict(row) for row in rows]
print(cleaning.strip_columns(rows, ["name", "email", "age"]))
print(cleaning.lowercase_columns(rows, ["email"]))
print(cleaning.title_columns(rows, ["name", "missing"]))
print(cleaning.title_columns(cleaning.strip_columns(rows, ["name"]), ["name"]))
assert rows == original, "inputs must not be mutated"
print(cleaning.strip_columns([], ["name"]))
print("ok")
